legend: Vasya plays the LionAge II. He was bored of playing with a stupid computer, so he installed this popular MMORPG, to fight with his friends. Vasya came up with the name of his character — non-empty string s, consisting of a lowercase Latin letters. However, in order not to put up a front of friends, Vasya has decided to change no more than k letters of the character name so that the new name sounded as good as possible. Euphony of the line is defined as follows: for each pair of adjacent letters x and y (x immediately precedes y) the bonus c(x, y) is added to the result. Your task is to determine what the greatest Euphony can be obtained by changing at most k letters in the name of the Vasya's character.
input: The first line contains character's name s and an integer number k (0 ≤ k ≤ 100). The length of the nonempty string s does not exceed 100. The second line contains an integer number n (0 ≤ n ≤ 676) — amount of pairs of letters, giving bonus to the euphony. The next n lines contain description of these pairs «x y c», which means that sequence xy gives bonus c (x, y — lowercase Latin letters,  - 1000 ≤ c ≤ 1000). It is guaranteed that no pair x y mentioned twice in the input data.
output: Output the only number — maximum possible euphony оf the new character's name.
note: In the first example the most euphony name will be looser. It is easy to calculate that its euphony is 36.

examples.input:
winner 4
4
s e 7
o s 8
l o 13
o o 8

abcdef 1
5
a b -10
b c 5
c d 5
d e 5
e f 5

output.ai: 请输出唯一的一个数字——新角色名字可能达到的最大悦耳度。

note.ai: 在第一个样例中，最悦耳的名字将是 looser。容易计算出，它的悦耳度为 36。

legend.ai: Vasya 正在玩 LionAge II。他厌倦了和愚蠢的电脑对战，于是安装了这款热门 MMORPG，想和朋友们一较高下。Vasya 为自己的角色取了一个名字——由小写拉丁字母组成的非空字符串 s。然而，为了不在朋友面前丢脸，Vasya 决定最多修改角色名中的 k 个字母，使新名字听起来尽可能悦耳。字符串的悦耳度定义如下：对于每一对相邻字母 x 和 y（x 紧接在 y 之前），将加分 c(x, y) 加到结果中。你的任务是确定：至多修改 Vasya 角色名中的 k 个字母后，能够获得的最大悦耳度是多少。

input.ai: 第一行包含角色名 s 和一个整数 k（0 ≤ k ≤ 100）。非空字符串 s 的长度不超过 100。第二行包含一个整数 n（0 ≤ n ≤ 676）——为悦耳度提供加分的字母对数量。接下来的 n 行包含这些字母对的描述 «x y c»，表示字符串 xy 可获得加分 c（x、y 为小写拉丁字母，−1000 ≤ c ≤ 1000）。保证输入数据中不会重复出现同一个字母对。
